newsitem.title: UK: Sterling/mark dragged down as cable tumbles.
newsitem.headline: Sterling/mark dragged down as cable tumbles.

text.p: 1400 GMT - Stg down, decline led by losses cable suffered after dollar/mark topped 1.80 for first time in 71 months. Stg/mark dragged down after cable sliced through $1.68.
* Cable down as low as $1.6692, weakest since July 2. Last at $1.6709/16 vs $1.6880/90 late Monday in Europe. Stg/mark at 3.0058/68 vs 3.0200/10 Monday, eyeing support at 3.0030 marks.
* Stg/mark back near lows set earlier in Europe after Germany's Waigel said stg, dollar strength vs mark reflected overreaction. Said Germany wanted strong mark, that it was in contact with G7.
